instruction: Create an animated GIF called src_clip.gif from a 5-second segment (starting at 3 seconds) of the video src.mp4 on the desktop using VLC and GIMP.

metadata.explanation: This task requires creating a 5-second animated GIF from a video using VLC and GIMP. The evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) format is GIF, (3) file size is reasonable (10KB-5MB), (4) dimensions are within normal range (100-2000px), (5) GIF is animated (not static), (6) duration is approximately 5 seconds (4.5-5.5s tolerance), and (7) frame count is reasonable (10-500 frames). Score breakdown: format=0.2, file_size=0.15, dimensions=0.15, is_animated=0.2, duration=0.3. Note: The exact 3-second start mark cannot be verified without reference frames, but duration verification ensures correct clip length.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts all animation properties: is_animated, n_frames, duration calculated from frame delays using PIL
Metric verifies file format (GIF), size sanity (10KB-5MB), dimensions (100-2000px), animation status (is_animated=True), and duration (4.5-5.5s with tolerance)
Duration verification (4.5-5.5s) directly addresses the instruction's 5-second requirement with reasonable tolerance
Animation check (is_animated) ensures the output is actually an animated GIF, not a static single-frame image
Frame count validation (10-500 frames) provides additional sanity check for animation quality
Scoring breakdown is logical: format=0.2, file_size=0.15, dimensions=0.15, is_animated=0.2, duration=0.3 (duration weighted highest as most critical)
Acknowledged limitation: Cannot verify exact 3-second start mark without reference frames from source video, but this is a reasonable limitation documented in metadata
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider tightening duration tolerance from ±0.5s to ±0.3s for stricter verification (currently 4.5-5.5s, could be 4.7-5.3s)
Minor: Frame count check is currently informational only (worth 0.0 points). Consider adding 0.05 points for frame count validation to ensure better quality control
